phases.objective: Provide a workflow-dispatch-only live verifier that binds Production DNS, TLS, HTTP, service identity, branch identity, and deployed commit identity to one exact reviewed SHA without credentials or runtime mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Production Runtime Parity Evidence workflow_dispatch with an exact expected Production SHA
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A structured JSON and Markdown artifact proves every required mad4b.com /version endpoint resolved DNS, completed an authorized TLS handshake, returned HTTP 200, identified http_generic_api_connector, reported branch Production, and exposed the exact expected deployed commit SHA; otherwise the workflow fails closed with the first bounded secret-free mismatch.
steps: Run repository-only reporter regressions before any live request.
Checkout trusted main tooling with persisted credentials disabled.
Require an exact lowercase 40-character expected SHA and exact Production branch identity.
Accept only credential-free HTTPS mad4b.com URLs targeting exactly /version.
Resolve DNS and store only SHA-256 hashes of returned addresses.
Complete an authorized TLS handshake and record bounded certificate metadata.
Fetch each endpoint with redirects disabled, a fixed timeout, and a 64 KiB response limit.
Persist only HTTP metadata, a response SHA-256 digest, and the three reviewed runtime identity fields.
Fail every required endpoint on DNS, TLS, HTTP, JSON, service, branch, or deployed-SHA mismatch while allowing explicitly optional endpoints to report warnings.
Upload JSON and Markdown under if: always() before enforcing the structured decision.
Reject any report that claims repository mutation, provider dispatch, credential access, SQL execution, migration Apply, or external send.
assertions: The workflow has no push, schedule, pull_request_target, issue_comment, or deployment trigger.
Live probing runs only for workflow_dispatch and never for pull_request.
The workflow uses contents: read and checkout persist-credentials=false.
Endpoint URLs cannot include credentials, query strings, fragments, non-HTTPS schemes, non-mad4b.com hosts, or paths other than /version.
DNS addresses are hashed before persistence.
TLS verification uses rejectUnauthorized=true and fails closed on handshake, authorization, or timeout errors.
HTTP redirects are not followed and response bodies are bounded before parsing.
The raw response body and unknown JSON fields are never written to the artifact.
Required endpoints pass only when service equals http_generic_api_connector, deployed_commit_sha equals the exact requested SHA, and deployment branch equals Production.
The report declares secrets_included=false and all mutation/effect flags false.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only and are never required to reconstruct the canonical decision.

phases.objective: Dispatch the verifier for Production c0f9d9fa84bfbf9edf4967a11a94758cb1491ad3, attach the run-bound artifact to issue 4948, and reconcile any host topology exception explicitly.
Add bounded retry policy, certificate-expiry thresholds, multi-address parity, and artifact publication to the canonical issue evidence path without weakening first-failure reporting.
Run the exact verifier against a non-production deployment before future protected promotions.
Require a successful run-bound live parity artifact after every Production promotion before declaring deployment complete.
